items.hebrew: אַתָּה חוֹנֵן לְאָדָם דַּעַת, וּמְלַמֵּד לֶאֱנוֹשׁ בִּינָה.
items.translation: You favor humankind with knowledge and teach mortals understanding.
items.translit: ʾatta ḥonen lĕʾadham da'ath, umĕlammedh leʾĕnosh bina.

items.label: Motzaei Shabbat / Yom Tov — Ata Hivdalta

items.hebrew: אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּ בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל וּבֵין אוֹר לְחֹשֶׁךְ וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים וּבֵין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
items.translation: You have distinguished between holy and profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, and between the seventh day and the six days of labor.
items.translit: ʾatta hivdalta ben qodhesh lĕḥol uven ʾor lĕḥoshekh uven yisraʾel la'ammim uven yom hashshĕvi'i lĕshesheth yĕme hamma'ăseh

items.hebrew: וְחָנֵּנוּ מֵאִתְּךָ חָכְמָה בִּינָה וָדָעַת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חוֹנֵן הַדָּעַת.
items.translation: Favor us with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge from You. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who favors us with knowledge.
items.translit: wĕḥannenu meʾittĕkha ḥokhma bina wadha'ath. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ḥonen hadda'ath.

items.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ לְתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה.
items.translation: Bring us back, our Father, to Your Torah, and return us in complete repentance before You. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who desires repentance.
items.translit: hăshivenu ʾavinu lĕthorathekha, wĕhaḥăzirenu bithshuva shĕlema lĕfanekha. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, haroṣeh bithshuva.

items.hebrew: סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חַנּוּן הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלֹחַ.
items.translation: Forgive us, our Father, for You are a good and forgiving God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, gracious One who forgives abundantly.
items.translit: sĕlaḥ lanu ʾavinu, ki ʾel ṭov wĕsallaḥ ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ḥannun hammarbeh lisloaḥ.

items.hebrew: רְאֵה נָא בְעָנְיֵנוּ, כִּי אֵל גּוֹאֵל חָזָק אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Look, please, upon our affliction, for You are a mighty redeeming God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, Redeemer of Israel.
items.translit: rĕʾeh naʾ vĕ'onyenu, ki ʾel goʾel ḥazaq ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, goʾel yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: רְפָאֵנוּ יְיָ וְנֵרָפֵא, כִּי אֵל רוֹפֵא רַחְמָן וְנֶאֱמָן אָתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, רוֹפֵא חוֹלֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Heal us, Adhonay, and we shall be healed, for You are a faithful and merciful healing God. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who heals the sick of His people Israel.
items.translit: rĕfaʾenu Adhonay wĕnerafeʾ, ki ʾel rofeʾ raḥman wĕneʾĕman ʾatta. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, rofeʾ ḥole 'ammo yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: בקיץ:
items.translation: In summer:

items.hebrew: בָּרְכֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֵינוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים.
items.translation: Bless us, Adhonay our God, in all the work of our hands, for You are a good and beneficent God who blesses the years. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who blesses the years.
items.translit: barĕkhenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bĕkhol ma'ăse yadhenu, ki ʾel ṭov umeṭiv ʾatta umĕvarekh hashshanim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕvarekh hashshanim.

items.hebrew: בחורף:
items.translation: In winter:

items.hebrew: בָּרֵךְ עָלֵינוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת הַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת כָּל מִינֵי תְבוּאָתָהּ לְטוֹבָה, וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה עַל כָּל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים.
items.translation: Bless for us, Adhonay our God, this year and all the varieties of its produce for good, and give dew and rain for blessing upon the whole face of the earth, for You are a good and beneficent God who blesses the years. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who blesses the years.
items.translit: barekh 'alenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu ʾeth hashshana hazzoʾth wĕʾeth kol mine thĕvuʾathah lĕṭova, wĕthen ṭal umaṭar livrakha 'al kol pĕne haʾădhama, ki ʾel ṭov umeṭiv ʾatta umĕvarekh hashshanim. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕvarekh hashshanim.

items.hebrew: תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ, וְקַבְּצֵנוּ יַחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאַרְצֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
items.translation: Sound the great shofar for our freedom, and bring us together from the four corners of the earth to our land. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who gathers the scattered of His people Israel.
items.translit: tĕqa' bĕshofar gadhol lĕḥeruthenu, wĕqabbĕṣenu yaḥadh meʾarba' kanfoth haʾareṣ lĕʾarṣenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕqabbeṣ nidhḥe 'ammo yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: הָשִׁיבָה שׁוֹפְטֵינוּ כְּבָרִאשׁוֹנָה וְיוֹעֲצֵינוּ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, וּמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדְּךָ, בְּחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים, בְּצֶדֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּט. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מֶלֶךְ אוֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט.
items.translation: Restore our judges as of old, and our counselors as at first, and reign over us, You alone, Adhonay, in kindness and mercy, in righteousness and justice. Blessed are You, Adhonay, King who loves righteousness and justice.
items.translit: hashiva shofĕṭenu kĕvariʾshona wĕyo'ăṣenu kĕvattĕḥilla, umĕlokh 'alenu mĕhera ʾatta Adhonay lĕvaddĕkha, bĕḥesedh uvĕraḥămim, bĕṣedheq uvĕmishpaṭ. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, melekh ʾohev ṣĕdhaqa umishpaṭ.

items.hebrew: לַמִּינִים וְלַמַּלְשִׁינִים אַל תְּהִי תִקְוָה, וּמַלְכוּת הָרִשְׁעָה מְהֵרָה תְעַקֵּר וּתְשַׁבֵּר וּתְכַלֵּם וְתַכְנִיעֵם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹבֵר אוֹיְבִים וּמַכְנִיעַ מִינִים.
items.translation: Let there be no hope for informers and heretics, and may You quickly uproot, break, cast down, and subdue the dominion of wickedness, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who breaks enemies and subdues the arrogant.
items.translit: lamminim wĕlammalshinim ʾal tĕhi thiqwa, umalkhuth harish'a mĕhera thĕ'aqqer uthĕshabber uthĕkhallem wĕthakhni'em bimhera vĕyamenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shover ʾoyĕvim umakhnia' minim.

items.hebrew: עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים וְעַל הַחֲסִידִים, וְעַל שְׁאֵרִית עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית סוֹפְרֵיהֶם, וְעַל גֵּרֵי הַצֶּדֶק וְעָלֵינוּ, יֶהֱמוּ נָא רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ כִּי בְךָ בָטָחְנוּ, וְעַל חַסְדְּךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּאֱמֶת נִשְׁעָנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מִשְׁעָן וּמִבְטָח לַצַּדִּיקִים.
items.translation: Toward the righteous and the pious, toward the remnant of Your people the house of Israel, toward the survivors of their scholars, toward the righteous converts, and toward us — let Your mercy be stirred, Adhonay our God; may we never be ashamed, for we have trusted in You, and have truly relied on Your great kindness. Blessed are You, Adhonay, support and trust of the righteous.
items.translit: 'al haṣṣaddiqim wĕ'al haḥăsidhim, wĕ'al shĕʾerith 'ammĕkha beth yisraʾel, wĕ'al pĕleṭath beth sofĕrehem, wĕ'al gere haṣṣedheq wĕ'alenu, yehĕmu naʾ raḥămekha Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, ulĕ'olam loʾ nevosh ki vĕkha vaṭaḥĕnu, wĕ'al ḥasdĕkha haggadhol beʾĕmeth nish'annu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mish'an umivṭaḥ laṣṣaddiqim.

items.hebrew: תִּשְׁכּוֹן בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִירְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ, וּבְנֵה אוֹתָהּ בִּנְיַן עוֹלָם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם.
items.translation: Dwell within Jerusalem Your city as You have spoken, and build it as an everlasting structure, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who builds Jerusalem.
items.translit: tishkon bĕthokh yĕrushalayim 'irĕkha kaʾăsher dibbarta, uvĕneh ʾothah binyan 'olam bimhera vĕyamenu. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, boneh yĕrushalayim.

items.hebrew: אֶת צֶמַח דָּוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה תַצְמִיחַ, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּינוּ כָּל הַיּוֹם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה.
items.translation: Speedily cause the offshoot of David Your servant to flourish, for we wait for Your salvation all day. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who causes the standing of salvation to flourish.
items.translit: ʾeth ṣemaḥ dawīdh 'avdĕkha mĕhera thaṣmiaḥ, ki lishu'athĕkha qiwwinu kol hayyom. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, maṣmiaḥ qeren yĕshu'a.

items.hebrew: שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלַּת כָּל פֶּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
items.translation: Hear our voice, Adhonay our God, for You hear the prayer of every mouth. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who hears prayer.
items.translit: shĕma' qolenu, Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, ki ʾatta shomea' tĕfillath kol peh. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomea' tĕfilla.

items.hebrew: היה מהלך במקום סכנה כגון במקום גדודי חיות ולסטים והגיע זמן התפלה, מתפלל ברכה אחת. ומתפלל אותה כשהוא מהלך בדרך. ואם יכול לעמוד עומד. וכשהוא מגיע לישוב ותתקרר דעתו חוזר ומתפלל תפלה כתקנה תשע עשרה ברכות.
items.translation: One who is walking in a place of danger — such as a place of bands of wild animals or bandits — and the time for prayer arrives, prays one blessing, and prays it while walking along the way; if he is able to stand, he stands. And when he reaches a settled place and his mind is calmed, he must return and pray the prayer as ordained, of nineteen blessings. (Rambam, Laws of Prayer 4:19; codified in Shulchan Arukh/Rema, Orach Chaim 110:3)

items.hebrew: צָרְכֵי עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְרֻבִּין וְדַעְתָּם קְצָרָה. יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּתֵּן לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד כְּדֵי פַּרְנָסָתוֹ, וּלְכָל גְּוִיָּה וּגְוִיָּה דֵּי מַחֲסוֹרָהּ, וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה.
items.translation: The needs of Your people Israel are many, and their understanding is limited. May it be Your will, Adhonay our God, that You give to each and every one what is sufficient for their livelihood, and to each body what it lacks; and do what is good in Your eyes. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who hears prayer.
items.translit: ṣarĕkhe 'ammĕkha yisraʾel mĕrubbin wĕdha'tam qĕṣara. yĕhi raṣon millĕfanekha Adhonay ʾĕlohenu, shettitten lĕkhol ʾeḥadh wĕʾeḥadh kĕdhe parnasatho, ulĕkhal gĕwiyya ughĕwiyya de maḥăsorah, wĕhaṭṭov bĕ'enekha 'ăseh. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, shomea' tĕfilla.

items.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב, הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל, וּמְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה, וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ, וְחָנֵּנוּ מֵאִתְּךָ [במוצאי שבת ויום טוב: בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל] דָּעַת, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ, וּסְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ, וּגְאָלֵנוּ גְּאֻלָּה שְׁלֵמָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, וּרְפָאֵנוּ מִכָּל תַּחֲלוּאֵינוּ, וּבָרֵךְ שְׁנָתֵנוּ [בימות הגשמים: וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה], וְקַבְּצֵנוּ יַחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאַרְצֵנוּ, וּבְחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים תִּשְׁפְּטֵנוּ, וְאוֹיְבֶיךָ מְהֵרָה יִכָּרֵתוּ, וְשִׂים חֶלְקֵנוּ עִם הַצַּדִּיקִים, וּבְנֵה אֶת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִירְךָ, וְאֶת צֶמַח דָּוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה תַצְמִיחַ, וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים, וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ, וְנוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, וְשִׂים שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם.
items.translation: Blessed are You, Adhonay, our God and God of our ancestors, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob — the great, mighty, and awesome God, God Most High, who bestows lovingkindness, who owns all things, and who gives life to the dead; and You are holy and Your name is holy. Favor us with knowledge from You — [at the close of Shabbat and festivals: between the holy and the ordinary] — and return us in complete repentance before You; and forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; and redeem us with a complete redemption for Your name's sake; and heal us from all our ailments; and bless our year [in the rainy season: and grant dew and rain for blessing]; and gather us together from the four corners of the earth to our land; and judge us with kindness and mercy; and may Your enemies be swiftly cut off; and set our portion with the righteous; and build Jerusalem Your city; and speedily cause the offshoot of David Your servant to flourish; and let our eyes see Your merciful return to Zion; and hear our prayer; and we will thank You and recount Your praise; and grant peace upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who blesses His people Israel with peace.
items.translit: barukh ʾatta Adhonay, ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, ʾĕlohe ʾavraham, ʾĕlohe yiṣḥaq, weʾlohe ya'ăqov, haʾel haggadhol haggibbor wĕhannoraʾ, ʾel 'elyon, gomel ḥăsadhim ṭovim, qoneh hakkol, umĕḥayyeh methim ʾatta, wĕʾatta qadhosh wĕshimkha qadhosh, wĕḥannenu meʾittĕkha [vmwṣʾy shvth wywm ṭwv: ben qodhesh lĕḥol] da'ath, wĕhaḥăzirenu bithshuva shĕlema lĕfanekha, usĕlaḥ lanu ʾavinu ki ḥaṭaʾnu, ughĕʾalenu gĕʾulla shĕlema lĕma'an shĕmekha, urĕfaʾenu mikkol taḥăluʾenu, uvarekh shĕnathenu [vymwth hghshmym: wĕthen ṭal umaṭar livrakha], wĕqabbĕṣenu yaḥadh meʾarba' kanfoth haʾareṣ lĕʾarṣenu, uvĕḥesedh uvĕraḥămim tishpĕṭenu, wĕʾoyĕvekha mĕhera yikkarethu, wĕsim ḥelqenu 'īm haṣṣaddiqim, uvĕneh ʾeth yĕrushalayim 'irĕkha, wĕʾeth ṣemaḥ dawīdh 'avdĕkha mĕhera thaṣmiaḥ, wĕtheḥĕzena 'enenu bĕshuvĕkha lĕṣiyyon bĕraḥămim, ushĕma' tĕfillathenu, wĕnodheh lĕkha unĕsapper tĕhillathekha, wĕsim shalom 'alenu wĕ'al kol yisraʾel 'ammekha. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, hammĕvarekh ʾeth 'ammo yisraʾel bashshalom.
